items.note: S1.3 names the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection gates on triples of [h], the three stages, (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restoration of arbitrary scratch, matching Lemma lem:scalar-motifs. It does not give the per-invocation y_S <- y_S + x_S or the coefficient-cancellation argument, so nothing is derived.

S1.4 gives the frame-commutation reason and the endpoint operator D_sink D_source^{-1}, but it leaves out the route sign epsilon_w (line 816-818). That sign matters for the signed exchange (-Y,X) in the complex network. D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} is not written.

S1.5 has the nested nondegenerate labels, the central-wire returns as the only decreasing edges, the sum Wm-2N+2L and L<N/2. It does not give the loss h per edge, L=Ich, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, or the triple-indicator tensor construction that makes neighbouring lines orthogonal.

S1.6.1 states M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m and s=Wm-N+2L<Wm, with the P_U / -P_{U_a} assignment as method. The method says every edge rank equals the label dimension change. It misses the paper's exception (line 1162-1165): the N first X_a edges have rank one where the dimension change is zero, and that is what turns -2N into -N.

S2.1 gives the phase frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c<W_c m. It omits the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c. It also says the network realises C^{otimes m} on every role without the source/sink Z corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange, which the paper requires (1225-1227, 1283-1306).

The plan's route is L<N/2 (S1.5), then s<Wm (S1.6.1, S2.1), then deficit >20*2^-50 gives tau=1-2^-50 (S1.6.2). This follows the paper, but the step log m<20, the exact deficits eta_b and eta_c, and the complex exponent sigma with s_c/W_c<m^sigma are missing.

S1.1 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.2 states the controlled update and the unit scaling in O(V) but drops the hypothesis that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from O(b)-digit controls (lines 562-568).

S1.7 states the lower-lower factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, and S1.8 states exactly a interchanges plus O(V), as in Lemmas lem:lower-lower and lem:matrix-shear. Neither step shows the pivot elimination or the three-step D+H / swap / H-D trick.

The steps follow the proof: cyclic row split into W role streams, edge shears Phi_{A_e} by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, then D<-D-H, the shear, D<-H-D. Then s calls of volume V/W give F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and the geometric sum gives O(e^tau), with the fixed-tape parking schedule as in 1559-1615.

S1 states the permutation (p,h,g,d,z)->(p,d,g,h,z) in O(Vu^tau). S1.10 only alludes to high digits as rows, padding and power-width calls, with no sub-steps (no rho=O(log e) rows, no base-m split, no padding to [q^e]).

S2.2 states s_c child calls on f=e/m axes returning C^{otimes e}, and S2.3 states H_0^{otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{otimes D} S_D exactly. Missing are the binary change of basis P_M that moves residual directions into coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate), the inverse-child identity (eq:phase-inverse-child), and the fixed number of row additions.

S2.4 gives the XOR at selected positions, the whole-chunk cyclic shifts, the sorting repair of a small bad set, restoration of z and O(V(L^tau+1)). It omits delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^-K}, the full time bound, and the family conditions (A=O(p), R superpolynomial, K/log p->infinity) under which the simplified bound holds.

S2.5 states F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) from the row split and its unrolling to O(d^{lambda'}). It leaves out the leaf rule F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the condition max{lambda,sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda', the q_0 row chunks and the base-m pieces.

S2 and S2.7 state Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2 2^-p and one final truncation. The sub-steps follow the proof: phase recursion with s_c children, row split, packed basis changes, the recurrence, the guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) with A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, and conversion by eq:phase-butterfly-layer. The parameter bands and K=floor(d^c) are left implicit.

S3.1 states omega_t=y^{2r/t}, butterflies with signed-shift twiddles and the bit-reversed slot. S3.2 states the layout L and the cost. Character cancellation F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2 l 2^-p are not stated.

S3.4 has evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the established multiplier, centered residues and O(rp log(rp)). It says the step multiplies ring elements, but the lemma returns the normalized truncation Q_p(fg/r) with error below sqrt2 2^-p, and the plan omits that.

S3 states M_r=(f*g)/(rM) with error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^-p and the stated cost. S3.3-S3.5 follow the paper's route: retained LB order, pointwise packed products, opposite transform, exact scaling by M. The normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) with F^+F^-=I/M and the 3delta+eta error composition are not shown.

S4.1 and S4.2 state P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and its tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 and both costs. S4.1 drops the hypothesis theta>p/alpha^4 (it appears only in S5.1.2) and never defines P_s, P_t as the index maps j->tj, k->-sk. The Gaussian construction is not given.

Both identities are stated correctly: the chirp form of QF_t and the cancellation to (u*v)/S^2. S4.4 gives the reason R F^+ R=F^+ together with commutation with pointwise products, but neither the convolution normalization step nor the conjugation definition of RF^+_s is given.

S5.1 and its sub-steps give b, p=6b, d, K, T, t_i, the sizes, the prime interval, T/2<S<T and alpha^4 theta_i>p. The fixed exponent values (epsilon, c, lambda', delta), eta=1/(4d) and alpha are absent. The essential existence argument for the primes (the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval count, line 4108-4131) and their n^{o(1)} search are missing.

S5.3 states Phi: x->prod x_i^{mu_i} as an algebra isomorphism that preserves cyclic convolution, implemented by triangular controlled shifts. It does not define mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i or give the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j, and it gives no cost.

S5.4 states the twist x_d->zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r}, the diagonal coefficient scaling, the conversion of the negative wrap to the cyclic wrap, and that f*g/T is M_r conjugated by the twist. This matches lines 4303-4341.

S5.5 gives the source transform as A, chirp (twist, synthetic convolution, phases), B_0 and the 2^gamma scale. S5.6 lists the six operations with scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, following 4506-4534. The input scaling of the digits by 2^{-b-2}, which the 2^{2b+4} undoes, is omitted, as is the definition of the opposite transform by conjugation. S5 itself writes the second scale as 2^{2b+4}.

S6.1 gives E_s=9*2^gamma TL and the disk margins, S6.2 gives 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 and rounding, and S6.3 gives the carries, all correct. The intermediate bound E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2 L for the opposite transform and the use of gamma<=b/4 in the final inequality are not shown.

The steps follow the paper: normalized costs per Tp (table), margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^-181=2kappa, setup and exceptional sorting o(Tp), logarithmic factors absorbed by p^kappa, giving O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}). Only the schoolbook cutoff for small n is unmentioned.
S8 states that the bound gives liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, which negates the eventual lower bound T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n, as in lines 381-387.

errors.says: Method: assigning P_U (and -P_{U_a} at sources) makes each edge rank equal the label dimension change.
errors.paper: The N first edges on X_a have matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero, which is why s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b rather than W_b m-2N+2L_b.

errors.says: A route from w to rho(w) applies only the endpoint operator D_sink D_source^{-1}.
errors.paper: For a signed role permutation the route applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including the scalar sign.

errors.says: The controlled update costs O(V) when the controls precede the target on tape.
errors.paper: It costs O(V) if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from the fixed number of control values, each with O(b) digits.

errors.says: The whole network realises C^{otimes m} on every role.
errors.paper: Only after source and sink diagonal corrections and undoing the signed bank exchange; uncorrected, the X_a->Y_a route carries C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a).

errors.says: For gcd(s,t)=1 and s<t there are contractions A, B_0 with P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA.
errors.paper: The lemma also requires theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, p>100, 2<=alpha<sqrt p and t<2^p.

errors.says: The algorithm scales by S and 2^{2b+4}.
errors.paper: The two scalings are by S and then by 2^{2b+4}S; the second S reverses the normalization still in w=(u*v)/S (S5.6 has this right).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: scalar network, frames, labels, shear interface, matrix shear, interchange recurrence and width extension; then phase interface, packed additions, recurrence, guard widths and the simultaneous layer; then synthetic transform and convolution, resampling with chirp and cancellation, parameters, algorithm, precision and time accounting. It reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) and its negation of the conjecture. It thins out in several places: the label construction (no triple-indicator tensors or L=Ich), the extra N ranks in the bit interface, the P_M basis change in the phase recursion, the Gaussian resampling construction and its theta hypothesis, the normalization in the synthetic convolution, the E_w step of the error chain, and the prime-existence argument.
